entries.description: PACHACHRU LAPAN runakuna WASHAKURKAANAPAQ ISKIRBISHAKUNA KAYKUNATA ISKIRBIPAAKURAA
entries.subject: PACHACHRU LAPAN

spans.text: KAY PACHACHRU LAPAN RUNAKUNA WASHAKURKAANAPAQ ISKIRBISHAKUNA KAYKUNATA ISKIRBIPAAKURAA
Lapan runakuna chaynuyla washa kananpaqmi mana pisi rantisha runatanuy sirbichikunanpaqmi mana ima lutantas ruranakurkaananpaqmi, alipa rikanakurkaananpaqmi.
Lapan runakuna mayaq chayaq nasyunchruusi mandaqnintin kay iskirbishakunata yarpapaakunanpaq, jinaman yachrachipaakunanpaq.

entries.description: Lapan runakuna chay washasha kapaakunanta mana musyarmi
entries.subject: Lapan

spans.text: Lapan runakuna chay washasha kapaakunanta mana musyarmi, mana kaasukurmi runakuna qalayapaakusha lutan ruranakuyta, ashlinakuyta, kaykunam juchakachimanchi lapan runakunata.
Naatan imatas lutanta rurapakusha karqa amam yarqunmanchu nasyunninpita juklaa nasyunchru washapaakunanpaq, Lapan Nasyunpita Qutukaq runakuna manam munapaakunchu kaykuna rurakananta.

entries.description: mana kaasukurmi runakuna qalayapaakusha lutan ruranakuyta
entries.subject: mana kaasukurmi

spans.text: Lapan runakuna chay washasha kapaakunanta mana musyarmi, mana kaasukurmi runakuna qalayapaakusha lutan ruranakuyta, ashlinakuyta, kaykunam juchakachimanchi lapan runakunata.
Jinamanmi "Rimashaq" nirqa, rimapaakunanpaq, naatan munanqanman, Diosmansi u jukmansi yupachikurkaananpaq.
